page.title: Taste Profile
page.purpose: Show the listener the system's model of their taste — what it believes, how sure it is, and what it is still guessing at — and let them correct it directly. This surface is the product's central claim: the model is not a secret.

priorities.statement: Confidence is shown alongside belief. A strongly-held preference and a guess must never look the same.
Learned belief and listener-imposed constraints are visually distinct, and a constraint can always be removed.
The exploration control shows its effect, not just its setting.

states.description: Little evidence; most beliefs are low-confidence.
Listener has pinned, boosted, or banned attributes.
A sustained change in listening has been detected.
Served diversity has been narrowing persistently.

elements.description: Attributes the model weights most heavily.
Marks a listener-imposed constraint as distinct from learned belief.
What the current dial setting changes about the queue.
Warning that served diversity is contracting.

claims.statement: Every stated belief is accompanied by an indication of confidence.
Listener-imposed constraints are marked as such and can be removed.
The exploration control is accompanied by a description of what it changes.
Persistent narrowing of served diversity raises a visible warning.
With little evidence the profile presents low confidence rather than confident-looking beliefs.
